description: Spearhead the architecture and technical development of advanced Virtual Reality (VR) and Mixed Reality (MR) simulations, defining the technical stack using the Meta XR All-in-One SDK.

Designed and implemented a decoupled vehicle control system for a VR space simulation using the Strategy Design Pattern, separating input execution from locomotion behaviors to enable multi-method navigation.
Engineered a highly scalable core gameplay system utilizing a custom Command Pattern and hierarchical State Machine, establishing robust global state management and precise undo/redo systems.

Integrated Meta Voice SDK to build immersive, low-latency Mixed Reality voice-driven interactions, configuring optimized NLP models for bilingual (Arabic and English) voice detection within spatial computing environments.
Direct performance profiling and memory management workflows, leveraging architectural optimization to secure stable frame rates on standalone VR hardware (Meta Quest 2, Quest 3).

Drive the full software development life cycle (SDLC) for immersive Virtual Reality (VR) applications and 2D/3D interactive educational games, aligning technical execution with product line requirements.
Architect scalable interactive systems, game mechanics, and pedagogical scenarios using Unity and C#, enhancing software stability and code reusability across multiple platforms.

Collaborate with Quality Assurance (QA) teams to execute profiling and debugging workflows, eliminating critical runtime errors and maximizing cross-device usability for mixed dimensions (2D, 3D, and VR).
Engineered core gameplay mechanics and features for a large-scale, multiplayer educational game featuring Battle Royale systems and real-time player synchronization.
Integrated REST APIs to handle dynamic game data, bridging communication between the Unity client and backend cloud services.
Implemented secure user authentication systems using OAuth 2.0, enabling seamless and robust Google and Facebook third-party login flows.
Developed core architecture and script logic for a real-time farming simulation game, managing complex resource states and time-dependent mechanics.
Integrated a proprietary, customized API to synchronize user progression, inventory systems, and real-time game states with the database backend.
Executed geometric scene layout configurations and contributed to level design, improving overall rendering performance and scene transition efficiency.
